description: TaxPower GST software starts at ₹7,000 + GST for CAs. See GST, billing and TDS software prices, yearly AMC, LAN cost and the 30-day free trial.
summary: TaxPower GST software starts at ₹7,000 + GST for CAs. See GST, billing and TDS software prices, yearly AMC, LAN cost and the 30-day free trial.

blocks.v: Looking for GST software price, TDS software price or the cost of GST billing software with e-invoice? TaxPower is priced as a one-time installation fee plus a yearly renewal (AMC) from the second year. For CAs, **TaxPower GST starts at ₹7,000 + GST**, and the **Complete Suite (GST + Billing + TDS) is ₹15,000 + GST**. The price depends on two things: which modules you choose, and whether you pick the Professional or the Business edition. This guide explains every number so you know your total cost before you ask for a quotation.
How GST software pricing works at TaxPower

You pay the installation fee once, when the software is installed. Support and software updates are free for the first year after purchase. From the second year, an annual AMC keeps support and updates going.

v: **18% GST** is added on top of the installation price shown, so your invoice total is higher than the price in the table.
**LAN access is optional** and charged separately for every additional computer.
Your **product key is sent by email** after payment is confirmed.

blocks.v: **Note:** Prices below are taken from the TaxPower [pricing page](pricing) and can change without notice. Always confirm the latest price with us before you pay.
GST software for CA firms or for a company: which edition do you need?
**Professional** is made for chartered accountants, tax consultants and practices that file returns for several clients and need client-wise records.
**Business** is made for companies and accounts teams that prepare returns for their own registrations.
If you are not sure, share the GSTINs and TANs you handle and we will recommend an edition during a free demo.
TaxPower GST, billing and TDS software price list
All amounts are in Indian rupees. Installation is a one-time fee, and 18% GST is extra.
What you get in each module

v: **TaxPower GST:** prepares and uploads GST returns, downloads GSTR-1, 2A and 2B data, reconciles ITC and tracks filing status.
**TaxPower Billing:** invoices, e-invoices, e-way bills, masters and reports.
**TaxPower TDS:** 24Q, 26Q, 27Q and 27EQ returns, PAN and FVU validation, challans and Form 16 / 16A certificates.

blocks.v: Is the Complete Suite cheaper than buying GST, billing and TDS separately?

Yes. Buying the three modules separately in the Professional edition costs ₹17,000 for installation (₹7,000 + ₹5,000 + ₹5,000). The Complete Suite is ₹15,000, so you save ₹2,000 on installation. Its yearly AMC is ₹8,000.
LAN (multi-user) charges for GST software
If more than one computer in your office needs to use TaxPower on the same network, you can add LAN access. It is not included in the installation price.
Example: total cost of GST and TDS software for a CA firm
A CA firm picks the **Professional Complete Suite** and wants 2 additional computers on the LAN.

Try the GST software free for 30 days

You do not have to decide on price alone. TaxPower GST, Billing and TDS each come with a **30-day free trial**, and our team in Nagpur helps you install it and shows the workflows you use most. Read the [free trial](free-trial) page, check the [system requirements](system-requirements), and download the setup from the [downloads](downloads) page.
